## Why it matters

This course site documents a graduate seminar on digital history that combines weekly readings with hands-on work on topics such as text analysis, mapping, and online exhibits.

It is a useful teaching reference because the syllabus makes methodological priorities, assignments, and learning goals explicit for instructors and students.
